summary: Rice, beef, chicken, wheat and corn come fast, milk and eggs follow, and soybeans and potatoes finish it; the fruit (tomatoes #11, apples, bananas) and coffee are the traps.
reasons: Builder's replays: a casual who started with crops found 10 with 1 life lost (sugar, coffee, cotton, bananas cost lives); one who started with fruit found 8 and ran out on apples, bananas, coffee, tomatoes and oranges. A fan found 10. A 90-second Blitz scores 30+: almost every food a player names is in the 48.

Data is 3 only for its age: FAO's gross production value for 2016, the only year Wikipedia has, said in the prompt. The ten are the world's staples, so a newer year would likely reorder them more than replace them (not checked). With that accepted (data 4) it is an easy daily and a deep Blitz.
Named as people say them (Pork for "Pig, meat", Corn for maize); fish, cocoa, oats and other foods outside FAO's 50 are free. "dairy" and "poultry" don't hand over milk or chicken.
fixes: Refresh when Wikipedia has a newer year of FAO's gross production value (the page says its data is for 2016).
